title: ProcartaPlex Protocol-2
author: Opentrons
materials: User will be prompted for off-deck processing.

steps.title: Distribute first wash buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute Wash Buffer from Column 1 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Distribute second wash buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute Wash Buffer from Column 2 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Add detection antibodies
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute 25 µL Detection Antibodies from Column 8 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Distribute third wash buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute Wash Buffer from Column 3 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Distribute fourth wash buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute Wash Buffer from Column 4 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Add SAP enzyme
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute 50 µL SAP from Column 10 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Distribute fifth wash buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute Wash Buffer from Column 5 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Distribute sixth wash buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute Wash Buffer from Column 6 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing.

steps.title: Add reading buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up tips, distribute 120 µL Reading Buffer from Column 12 to all wells of the Destination Plate, then drop used tips in the waste bin. User will be prompted for off‑deck processing (end of protocol).
